actual_observation: MiniWoB callfc-01M6HD69EP6B34GKBR40XKYH83 emitted incorrect Mistral regex warning while loading the pinned local BU tokenizer.

primary_sources.finding: Local config version4.57.3 falls between the <=4.57.2 model-type exclusion and >=5.0.0 skip. It can therefore trigger the Mistral warning for a Qwen config. The warning branch does not replace the regex; explicit true selects replacement.
An upstream reproduction reports this same warning with locally saved Qwen under4.57.6; maintainers report it absent on newer main.

interpretation: This is evidence of an overbroad warning condition, not evidence that this tokenizer is broken. No automatic Mistral regex change is justified. Actual tokenization correctness remains separately untested.
